name: v0.24.1
body:
## Highlights

- Preserve inline code spans that end in a backslash, such as Windows directory paths, while continuing to translate the surrounding Markdown.
- Render Arabic image text with the correct shaping and direction in both image modes, including when Pillow is built without RAQM.
- Require dnspython 2.9.2 or later in the 2.x series and pin 2.9.2 for Poetry and requirements installs.

## What's Changed

- Core: Fix inline code spans ending after backslashes by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/590
- Core: Draw Arabic image text correctly when Pillow has Raqm by @DrEssam97 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/587
- Build: Update dnspython to 2.9.2 by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/591
- Build: Bump version to 0.24.1 by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/592

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/compare/v0.24.0...v0.24.1)
